policy: Merge only complementary extracted fragments of the same reference behavior.
Use only model-extracted text, never fill missing details from Gold Standard.
Preserve source IDs, paragraphs, and verbatim fields.
Merge does not imply FULL; label completeness independently.

fragments.rule_description: Handle journal write error and rollback account updates
fragments.action: Set alert code 9002, message Journal write error, perform rollback account, close files, and go back

fragments.rule_description: Rollback account balance to old balance if account was updated and account read is successful during a rollback procedure
fragments.action: move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE and rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD
fragments.evidence: if WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1 move RCV-ACCOUNT-NUMBER to ACC-NUMBER read ACCOUNT-FILE key is ACC-NUMBER if WS-ACC-STATUS = "00" move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD end-if end-if

merged_groups.note: Journal write failure trigger and rollback implementation are complementary; lack of rollback rewrite-success check not explicitly noted.
